templates.WHY_C: {profile} has a relative fit level of {C}, ranked {rank}/{n_ranked}. Contributions: numerology α·NF* = {c_nf}, skills β·SR* = {c_sr}, environment γ·ENV* = {c_env}. This is not a probability of success.
templates.WHY_NF: {ec}/5 signal groups match the profile's archetypes ({groups}). NF = {nf}.
templates.WHY_NF_NONE: No signal group matches the profile's archetypes (EC = 0), so the profile is not ranked.
templates.WHY_SR: Self-rated skills for the profile's 3 archetypes: {kn}. SR = {sr} ({sr_cmp} threshold 0.625 ⇔ average 3.5/5).
templates.WHY_ENV_YES: Your preferred environment ({env}) matches the profile's typical environment.
templates.WHY_ENV_NO: Your preferred environment ({env}) differs from the profile's environment ({profile_env}).
templates.LABEL_PRIORITY: Label "Priority": rule 3 – EC = {ec} ≥ 2 and SR = {sr} ≥ 0.625, no weak skills.
templates.LABEL_CONSIDER: Label "Consider": rule 4 – no weak skills but not yet EC ≥ 2 and SR ≥ 0.625 ({why}).
templates.BEST_PRIORITY: Top-1 is currently "Challenge". The best "Priority" profile is {profile} (rank {rank}).
templates.TIE: {n} profiles share the level {C}; their order follows the tie-break rule (the profile listed first among the 35 profiles).
templates.STEP5: For {target} to reach "Priority": raise weak skills by {steps_weak} level(s) and make up {gap} weighted points to SR_min (≈ {steps_main} level(s) in the main skills).
templates.STEP5_EC_LOW: {target}: at most "Consider" because EC = {ec} < 2 – numerology signals are fixed and cannot be improved through skills.
templates.STEP5_EC0: {target}: EC = 0 – no numerology signal supports it (fixed).
templates.DISCLAIMER: Reference system on simulated data. Numerology has no scientific predictive value (E10).

rules.V_DOB: Birth year outside the data range 2009–2011
rules.V_CHAR: Name has characters outside A–Z – removed for calculation
rules.V_TZ: Contains digraph TZ – KB04 applied (differs from Excel v6)
rules.V_MAJOR: Target major is not among the 300 majors – cannot be scored
rules.V_EC0: Target major has EC = 0 – profile excluded from ranking
rules.V_EC1: Only 1 signal group supports it – weak evidence
rules.V_ONE_PROFILE: Only 1 eligible profile – min–max normalization is not meaningful
rules.V_CONFLICT: Conflict: high skill readiness but no numerology signal – present both sides
rules.V_TIE: Some profiles are tied – order follows the tie-break rule (profile listed first)
rules.V_ADMIT: No admission cut-off data for this major yet
rules.V_SIM: Simulated data – numerology has no scientific predictive value (E10)
